versos.grego: Παῦλος ἀπόστολος Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ διὰ θελήματος Θεοῦ κατ’ ἐπαγγελίαν ζωῆς τῆς ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ

controles.web: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ through the will of God, according to the promise of the life which is in Christ Jesus,
controles.kjv: Paul, an apostle of Jesus Christ by the will of God, according to the promise of life which is in Christ Jesus,
controles.livre: Paulo, apóstolo de Cristo Jesus, pela vontade de Deus, segundo a promessa da vida que está em Cristo Jesus,

versos.grego: Τιμοθέῳ ἀγαπητῷ τέκνῳ· χάρις, ἔλεος, εἰρήνη ἀπὸ Θεοῦ Πατρὸς καὶ Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν.

controles.web: to Timothy, my beloved child: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
controles.kjv: To Timothy, my dearly beloved son: Grace, mercy, and peace, from God the Father and Christ Jesus our Lord.
controles.livre: a Timóteo, meu amado filho. Graça, misericórdia, e paz, da parte de Deus Pai, e de Cristo Jesus, nosso Senhor.

versos.grego: Χάριν ἔχω τῷ Θεῷ, ᾧ λατρεύω ἀπὸ προγόνων ἐν καθαρᾷ συνειδήσει, ὡς ἀδιάλειπτον ἔχω τὴν περὶ σοῦ μνείαν ἐν ταῖς δεήσεσίν μου νυκτὸς καὶ ἡμέρας,

controles.web: I thank God, whom I serve as my forefathers did, with a pure conscience. How unceasing is my memory of you in my petitions, night and day
controles.kjv: I thank God, whom I serve from my forefathers with pure conscience, that without ceasing I have remembrance of thee in my prayers night and day;
controles.livre: Agradeço a Deus, a quem desde os meus antepassados sirvo com uma consciência pura, de que sem cessar tenho memória de ti nas minhas orações noite e dia.

versos.grego: ἐπιποθῶν σε ἰδεῖν, μεμνημένος σου τῶν δακρύων, ἵνα χαρᾶς πληρωθῶ,

controles.web: longing to see you, remembering your tears, that I may be filled with joy;
controles.kjv: Greatly desiring to see thee, being mindful of thy tears, that I may be filled with joy;
controles.livre: Lembro-me das tuas lágrimas, e desejo muito te ver, para me encher de alegria;

versos.grego: ὑπόμνησιν λαβὼν τῆς ἐν σοὶ ἀνυποκρίτου πίστεως, ἥτις ἐνῴκησεν πρῶτον ἐν τῇ μάμμῃ σου Λωΐδι καὶ τῇ μητρί σου Εὐνίκῃ, πέπεισμαι δὲ ὅτι καὶ ἐν σοί.

controles.web: having been reminded of the sincere faith that is in you; which lived first in your grandmother Lois, and your mother Eunice, and, I am persuaded, in you also.
controles.kjv: When I call to remembrance the unfeigned faith that is in thee, which dwelt first in thy grandmother Lois, and thy mother Eunice; and I am persuaded that in thee also.
controles.livre: Trago à memória a fé não fingida que há em ti, fé que habitou primeiro na tua avó Loide, e na tua mãe Eunice; e tenho certeza que também em ti.

versos.grego: Δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν ἀναμιμνῄσκω σε ἀναζωπυρεῖν τὸ χάρισμα τοῦ Θεοῦ, ὅ ἐστιν ἐν σοὶ διὰ τῆς ἐπιθέσεως τῶν χειρῶν μου.

controles.web: For this cause, I remind you that you should stir up the gift of God which is in you through the laying on of my hands.
controles.kjv: Wherefore I put thee in remembrance that thou stir up the gift of God, which is in thee by the putting on of my hands.
controles.livre: Por essa causa lembro-te de reacenderes o dom de Deus que está em ti pela imposição das minhas mãos.

versos.grego: οὐ γὰρ ἔδωκεν ἡμῖν ὁ Θεὸς πνεῦμα δειλίας, ἀλλὰ δυνάμεως καὶ ἀγάπης καὶ σωφρονισμοῦ.

controles.web: For God didn’t give us a spirit of fear, but of power, love, and self-control.
controles.kjv: For God hath not given us the spirit of fear; but of power, and of love, and of a sound mind.
controles.livre: Pois Deus não nos deu espírito de medo; mas sim de força, de amor, e de moderação.

versos.grego: Μὴ οὖν ἐπαισχυνθῇς τὸ μαρτύριον τοῦ Κυρίου ἡμῶν μηδὲ ἐμὲ τὸν δέσμιον αὐτοῦ, ἀλλὰ συνκακοπάθησον τῷ εὐαγγελίῳ κατὰ δύναμιν Θεοῦ,

controles.web: Therefore don’t be ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner; but endure hardship for the Good News according to the power of God,
controles.kjv: Be not thou therefore ashamed of the testimony of our Lord, nor of me his prisoner: but be thou partaker of the afflictions of the gospel according to the power of God;
controles.livre: Portanto não te envergonhes do testemunho do nosso Senhor, nem de mim, que sou prisioneiro dele; em vez disso, participa das aflições do Evangelho segundo o poder de Deus.

versos.grego: τοῦ σώσαντος ἡμᾶς καὶ καλέσαντος κλήσει ἁγίᾳ, οὐ κατὰ τὰ ἔργα ἡμῶν ἀλλὰ κατὰ ἰδίαν πρόθεσιν καὶ χάριν, τὴν δοθεῖσαν ἡμῖν ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ πρὸ χρόνων αἰωνίων,

controles.web: who saved us and called us with a holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given to us in Christ Jesus before times eternal,
controles.kjv: Who hath saved us, and called us with an holy calling, not according to our works, but according to his own purpose and grace, which was given us in Christ Jesus before the world began,
controles.livre: Ele nos salvou, e chamou com um chamado santo; não conforme as nossas obras, mas sim, conforme a sua própria intenção,  e a graça que nos foi dada em Cristo Jesus antes dos princípios dos tempos;

versos.grego: φανερωθεῖσαν δὲ νῦν διὰ τῆς ἐπιφανείας τοῦ Σωτῆρος ἡμῶν Χριστοῦ Ἰησοῦ, καταργήσαντος μὲν τὸν θάνατον φωτίσαντος δὲ ζωὴν καὶ ἀφθαρσίαν διὰ τοῦ εὐαγγελίου,

controles.web: but has now been revealed by the appearing of our Savior, Christ Jesus, who abolished death, and brought life and immortality to light through the Good News.
controles.kjv: But is now made manifest by the appearing of our Saviour Jesus Christ, who hath abolished death, and hath brought life and immortality to light through the gospel:
controles.livre: mas agora é manifesta pela aparição do nosso Salvador Cristo Jesus, que anulou a morte, e trouxe para a luz a vida e a imortalidade  por meio do evangelho;

versos.grego: εἰς ὃ ἐτέθην ἐγὼ κήρυξ καὶ ἀπόστολος καὶ διδάσκαλος·

controles.web: For this, I was appointed as a preacher, an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
controles.kjv: Whereunto I am appointed a preacher, and an apostle, and a teacher of the Gentiles.
controles.livre: do qual eu fui constituído pregador e apóstolo, e instrutor.

versos.grego: δι’ ἣν αἰτίαν καὶ ταῦτα πάσχω, ἀλλ’ οὐκ ἐπαισχύνομαι, οἶδα γὰρ ᾧ πεπίστευκα, καὶ πέπεισμαι ὅτι δυνατός ἐστιν τὴν παραθήκην μου φυλάξαι εἰς ἐκείνην τὴν ἡμέραν.

controles.web: For this cause I also suffer these things.   Yet I am not ashamed, for I know him whom I have believed, and I am persuaded that he is able to guard that which I have committed to him against that day.
controles.kjv: For the which cause I also suffer these things: nevertheless I am not ashamed: for I know whom I have believed, and am persuaded that he is able to keep that which I have committed unto him against that day.
controles.livre: Por causa disso também sofro essas coisas; porém não me envergonho. Pois sei em quem tenho crido, e tenho certeza de que ele é poderoso para guardar o que lhe confiei  até aquele dia.

versos.grego: ὑποτύπωσιν ἔχε ὑγιαινόντων λόγων ὧν παρ’ ἐμοῦ ἤκουσας ἐν πίστει καὶ ἀγάπῃ τῇ ἐν Χριστῷ Ἰησοῦ·

controles.web: Hold the pattern of sound words which you have heard from me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
controles.kjv: Hold fast the form of sound words, which thou hast heard of me, in faith and love which is in Christ Jesus.
controles.livre: Preserva o exemplo das sãs palavras que tens ouvido de mim, na fé e no amor que há em Cristo Jesus.

versos.grego: τὴν καλὴν παραθήκην φύλαξον διὰ Πνεύματος Ἁγίου τοῦ ἐνοικοῦντος ἐν ἡμῖν.

controles.web: That good thing which was committed to you, guard through the Holy Spirit who dwells in us.
controles.kjv: That good thing which was committed unto thee keep by the Holy Ghost which dwelleth in us.
controles.livre: Guarda o bem que te foi confiado  por meio do Espírito Santo que habita em nós.

versos.grego: Οἶδας τοῦτο, ὅτι ἀπεστράφησάν με πάντες οἱ ἐν τῇ Ἀσίᾳ, ὧν ἐστιν Φύγελος καὶ Ἑρμογένης.

controles.web: This you know, that all who are in Asia turned away from me; of whom are Phygelus and Hermogenes.
controles.kjv: This thou knowest, that all they which are in Asia be turned away from me; of whom are Phygellus and Hermogenes.
controles.livre: Sabes isto, que todos os que estão na Ásia Romana me abandonaram, entre os quais estavam Fígelo e Hermógenes.

versos.grego: δῴη ἔλεος ὁ Κύριος τῷ Ὀνησιφόρου οἴκῳ, ὅτι πολλάκις με ἀνέψυξεν, καὶ τὴν ἅλυσίν μου οὐκ ἐπαισχύνθη,

controles.web: May the Lord grant mercy to the house of Onesiphorus, for he often refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain,
controles.kjv: The Lord give mercy unto the house of Onesiphorus; for he oft refreshed me, and was not ashamed of my chain:
controles.livre: O Senhor conceda misericórdia à casa de Onesíforo, pois muitas vezes ele me consolou, e não se envergonhou de eu estar em cadeias;

versos.grego: ἀλλὰ γενόμενος ἐν Ῥώμῃ σπουδαίως ἐζήτησέν με καὶ εὗρεν·—

controles.web: but when he was in Rome, he sought me diligently, and found me
controles.kjv: But, when he was in Rome, he sought me out very diligently, and found me.
controles.livre: Pelo contrário, quando veio a Roma, com muito empenho me procurou, e me encontrou.

versos.grego: δῴη αὐτῷ ὁ Κύριος εὑρεῖν ἔλεος παρὰ Κυρίου ἐν ἐκείνῃ τῇ ἡμέρᾳ·— καὶ ὅσα ἐν Ἐφέσῳ διηκόνησεν, βέλτιον σὺ γινώσκεις.

controles.web: (the Lord grant to him to find the Lord’s mercy in that day); and in how many things he served at Ephesus, you know very well.
controles.kjv: The Lord grant unto him that he may find mercy of the Lord in that day: and in how many things he ministered unto me at Ephesus, thou knowest very well.
controles.livre: O Senhor lhe conceda que naquele dia ele encontre misericórdia diante do Senhor. E tu sabes muito bem como ele me ajudou em Éfeso.
